text: In the California town of Santa Mira, Dr. Miles Bennell hears patients insist their relatives [have been replaced by impostors|threat|impostors and doubles], and a psychiatrist calls it mass hysteria. With Becky Driscoll he finds featureless bodies [emerging from seed pods in his greenhouse|origin|from another world], copies that [take over each person while they sleep|rules|it gets inside you]. As truckloads of pods leave for neighbouring towns, Miles flees onto the highway, [screaming warnings no one will hear|rules|no one believes you].
